column1: # The event registry (ADR 0009 point 6; architecture section 9): every event name the sim emits, the
# spec clause it reports (or sim, for the simulator's own state) and what it means. Gates and
# ksim-ctl wait read these names, so they are a contract; tools/guards/check_events.py keeps this
# file and the code in step. Fields are named in the description.

column3: description
the UE powered its card and read the subscription; usim=valid|invalid, supi
a 5GMM state change; from, to (the spec's names), clause (from the entity's transition table), why
a 5GMM STATUS sent or received; direction=ul|dl, cause
a UE NAS timer ran out; timer (T3510, T3511, T3502, T3516, T3520, T3521)
a REGISTRATION REQUEST sent; type, identity=suci|5g-guti, attempt (the attempt counter plus one)
a REGISTRATION ACCEPT taken; guti, tai_count, t3512_s, allowed_nssai (SSTs), sms_allowed
a REGISTRATION COMPLETE sent for the 5G-GUTI the accept assigned
a REGISTRATION REJECT taken; cause
a registration attempt ended without an accept; reason=T3510|released|reject, attempt (the counter after it)
an AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE sent; ngksi, stored=1 when it repeated the stored RES* for a repeated RAND
a challenge the UE did not accept; cause (#20, #21, #26, #71), consecutive
the UE deemed the network failed the authentication check (T3520, or three failed challenges) and released locally
an AUTHENTICATION REJECT taken: the USIM is invalid for 5GS
a SECURITY MODE COMMAND taken; ea, ia, ngksi, imeisv=0|1, container=0|1 (the whole REGISTRATION REQUEST returned)
a SECURITY MODE REJECT sent; cause (#23, #24)
a downlink 5GMM message not processed; message, verdict (unprotected, MAC, no context, …)
a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST sent; switch_off, identity, transmission (1, then T3521's retransmissions)
a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT taken: the UE is deregistered
a UE-initiated de-registration ended without an accept; reason=T3521|released
the UE camps on a cell (fixed camping, ledger A-12): MIB not barred, SIB1 lists the selected PLMN; cell (KAIR handle), tac, nci, plmn

a Paging record matched this UE's 5G-S-TMSI; state

RRCSetup taken and RRCSetupComplete sent with the NAS message; c_rnti
the setup failed (T300, random access, RRCReject); the NAS sees a lower layer failure; reason
AS security active: SecurityModeComplete sent integrity protected, unciphered; nia, nea, alg=nia<n>/nea<m>
SecurityModeFailure sent unprotected; reason
RRCReconfiguration applied and RRCReconfigurationComplete sent; added (srb2, drb<n>), nas (messages forwarded)
an RRCReconfiguration the UE cannot comply with; what
RRCRelease taken: RRC_IDLE
UECapabilityInformation sent; octets (the UE-NR-Capability)
a PDCP integrity failure on an SRB (re-establishment is not in P1: the connection is lost); bearer, count

a DL-DCCH message the UE could not decode; bearer, what
a message the UE's builders refused (a sim bug); what
